prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Produce one polished ORIGINAL Chinese technical textbook illustration for an embodied-AI foundations article. Landscape 1536x1024, light paper background #f6f6f5, cobalt blue #0837a5 and ink #171415, a very small amount of neutral gray. Flat precise technical line illustration with clear schematic robotic arms and grippers, readable Chinese sans-serif labels, generous spacing, large lettering (readable when image is shown at 780 pixels wide). No brand, watermark, title banner, gradients, pictorial human brains, decorative circuits or tiny paragraphs. Content accuracy and straightforward reading order matter.
Draw THREE stacked horizontal rows showing the same top-down tabletop scene, gripper starting at left and cup goal at right, with one obstacle between them. Align all three rows. Large labels at left: 路径, 轨迹, 控制. Row 1 路径: cobalt geometric curve goes from starting gripper around the obstacle to goal cup; short subtitle 经过哪里; no time labels. Row 2 轨迹: same curve and obstacle, three ghost gripper poses along route with accurate left-to-right time labels t0, t1, t2 and short subtitle 何时到达; tiny simple caption 时间仅作示意. Row 3 控制: zoom into one point of the same route showing a cobalt dashed target gripper pose (目标) and solid dark actual gripper pose (实际), a short arrow from actual toward target labelled 修正; a compact external sensor loop drawn below leads from actual robot state to 控制器 and command back to gripper; subtitle 根据反馈修正. Distinguish geometric route, timed motion and feedback execution through the pictures, not extra text. Arrow direction for correction must point actual toward target. Robot poses should be physically clear and no unnecessary arm anatomy.

Targeted correction to original generated image:
Edit this educational diagram. Preserve the TOP TWO ROWS exactly: 路径 and 轨迹 with their existing cup, obstacle, route and time samples. Repair ONLY the bottom 控制 row, maintaining the same paper/cobalt/ink art style and large Chinese text. Keep left title 控制 / 根据反馈修正. Replace the entire bottom-right diagram with a simple correct feedback controller loop: a small input label 目标位置 at x roughly 360 y730 points RIGHT into a box 控制器 centered around x650 y760; controller output arrow labelled 控制指令 points RIGHT into a simple top-down physical gripper at x1150 y760 labelled 实际夹爪. From that physical gripper, a separate clearly routed arrow loops DOWN then LEFT along the bottom y960, then UP into the controller, labelled 实际位置（反馈）. These three arrows MUST flow target→controller→gripper→controller. Do not point control commands at a cup. Above or next to the gripper show a small dashed cobalt target pose labelled 目标 and solid dark actual pose labelled 实际, with a short arrow from actual toward target labelled 修正. Keep content in bottom row y670 to1000 without clipping. No two-headed arrows, no ambiguous dangling arrows, no more extra nodes. Complete scientific schematic, clean and readable.
